name: cosmic-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by Giuseppe Bellamacina.

plugins.name: setup-sync
plugins.description: Push/pull your whole Claude Code setup (settings, plugins, MCP servers, skills, agents, hooks, LSP, mods) to a local folder; the agent replays the install of external tools on a new machine.

plugins.name: pr-review-helper
plugins.description: Find open GitHub pull requests with no review yet (by repo, user or topic, sorted by popularity or date) and write targeted reviews you confirm before they are posted under your own account.

plugins.name: prompt-queue
plugins.description: Decide what happens to a message sent while Claude works: steer the running task, queue it until the task is finished, or interrupt and send it now, with an editable queue above the prompt.
